name: Center

examples.title: Basic Usage
examples.code:
<Center aspectRatio="16by9" bgColor="light">
  <Loader textSize="3" ariaLabel="Loading the report" />
</Center>

examples.title: Several Children
examples.code: Nothing here yet.

examples.title: Inline
examples.code:
<Block>
  Sync is{' '}
  <Center
    display="inline-flex"
    bgColor="success"
    textColor="white"
    radius="rounded"
    p="1"
  >
    <Icon name="check" ariaLabel="on" />
  </Center>{' '}
  for every device.
</Block>

accessibility:
- **No role of its own:** a Center adds nothing to the accessibility tree, apart from `role="list"`
  on a `ul` or `ol`, which Safari otherwise drops once Bulma's reset hides the markers.
- **Order:** several children stay in their own order, so what's seen, the reading order and the
  Tab order agree.
- **What it centers names itself:** a loader or an icon in a Center needs its own accessible name,
  as `Loader`'s `ariaLabel` and `Icon`'s `ariaLabel` give it.
summary: The `Center` component centers its content on both axes. Use it for a loader, an icon or an empty state in the middle of a box, a card or a section. Give it a height, or put it in something that has one, to center down the middle as well as across. Several children sit side by side in the middle, with no gap unless you set one.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. With `ul` or `ol`, give it `li` children: it restates `role="list"`, which Bulma's list reset takes away in Safari.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children, when there are several. None by default.

props.name: display
props.description: `'inline-flex'` sizes it to its content, to center something inside a line of text. Needs Bulma's helper classes, as every `display` does.

props.name: children
props.description: What it lays out. The top and bottom margins Bulma gives them are zeroed, so `gap` is the only space between them, and a spacing helper such as `mt="2"` still adds to it. A `Columns` child keeps its own top and side margins, and takes at the bottom the one Bulma gives the last Columns in a container, the column gap pulled back in (none when gapless), so its columns line up.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the element `as` renders.

parts.catchAll: Remaining props of the element selected by as and Bulma helper props

types.name: BulmaGapStep
types.summary: A gap step as `gap`, `columnGap` and `rowGap` take it: a value from `validGaps`, or the same step written as a number (`gap={2}`, `gap={1.5}`). `Grid` took its gaps as numbers before the gap helpers were shared, so every gap prop still does.

types.name: LayoutElement
types.summary: The elements Stack, Group, Center and Flex can render as: Container's landmarks and sections, a list, a form or a fieldset.
